title: Nvidia invests $2B in optics maker Coherent

sources.quote: In addition, NVIDIA is investing $2 billion in Coherent to support research and development, future capacity and operations as Coherent builds out its U.S.- based manufacturing capabilities.

explain: Nvidia agreed to invest $2 billion in Coherent, a maker of lasers and optical transceivers for data center networks, to fund research and new US manufacturing. It was announced the same day as a matching $2 billion investment in Lumentum.
